summary_en: This study tests a spine stereotactic body radiotherapy regimen for localized metastases to the spinal column from solid tumors. Patients receive 40 Gy in 5 fractions (5 treatments), with cohort 2 patients who had prior spine radiotherapy receiving a risk-adapted spinal cord dose based on that earlier treatment; the total treatment period is not stated. The study aims to measure feasibility and tolerability, and the record does not name a primary outcome measure; the phase is not applicable.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa un régimen de radioterapia corporal estereotáctica de columna para metástasis localizadas en la columna vertebral originadas en tumores sólidos. Los pacientes reciben 40 Gy en 5 fracciones (5 tratamientos), y los pacientes del grupo 2 que recibieron radioterapia previa en la columna reciben una dosis de médula espinal ajustada al riesgo según ese tratamiento previo; el periodo total de tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca medir la factibilidad y la tolerabilidad, y el registro no nombra una medida de resultado principal; la fase no aplica.
who_for: Localized spine metastasis from a solid tumor, from C1 to L5, with limits on number of sites.
Pain score of 5 or higher at the treated site when not taking pain medication.
Cohort 2: prior spine radiotherapy, with at least 6 months since re-irradiation.
not_for: Radiosensitive cancers: myeloma, lymphoma, germ cell tumors, or small cell lung cancer.
Over 50% loss of vertebral body height or spinal instability from pathologic compression fracture.
Frank spinal cord compression, cord displacement, or epidural extension within 2 mm of the cord.
Rapid neurologic decline, spine MRI contraindicated, or pregnancy.
